time.title: Broad and Belvidere, Richmond, from the Sanborn fire-insurance map of 1924
time.note: Buildings traced from the Sanborn map of Richmond, volume 1 (1924), sheets 33 and 34, fitted to today's street corners (mean miss 2.3 m on sheet 33, 0.7 m on sheet 34). An auto row: sales rooms, repair shops and filling stations. Buildings standing today are drawn where the assessor dates them 1924 or earlier. Working draft.

curated.name: Richmond and Petersburg (Atlantic Coast Line) approach to Byrd Street Station
curated.note: The track from the north end of the Richmond and Petersburg bridge (OSM w710689016) across the Haxall Canal into Byrd Street Station at Seventh and Byrd Streets, the R&P's original Richmond station and later the Atlantic Coast Line's headquarters, closed in 1958. Today nothing of it is mapped north of the bridge. Approximate: one track along the middle of the station's throat, read by eye from the USGS 1:24,000 Richmond quadrangles of 1934 and 1956 (which show the line crossing the canal and fanning into the station yard between Seventh and Eighth Streets south of Byrd) and joined to the bridge's mapped end, about 20 m east of where the maps put it. Drawn with the bridge, from 1838 to 1970 (the R&P's depot stood at 8th and Byrd before Byrd Street Station, and the 1886 Sanborn map, volume 1, sheet 10, shows its tracks fanning in between 7th and 9th south of Canal); the years are the bridge's, not the track's.

curated.name: Chesapeake and Ohio approach to the Church Hill Tunnel
curated.note: The C&O's line to the Church Hill Tunnel's west portal, by 18th Street just north of Marshall: it left the old Virginia Central line west of 17th Street and curved southeast. The tunnel opened in 1873, collapsed on October 2, 1925, and its western end was sealed the following spring, so it is drawn through 1925 and not after. Its course: OSM's abandoned branch (w169784705) from the junction with today's Peninsula Subdivision south to 17th Street; then the C&O spur shown on the 1924–25 Sanborn map, volume 1, sheet 24, crossing the block between 17th and 18th Streets, Marshall and Clay, between the Richmond Cold Storage and International Harvester warehouses (the sheet fitted to the four corners of the block, to about a meter, and the line set midway between the warehouses standing today); then straight across 18th Street to the portal mapped in OSM (the tunnel, w6036486). Approximate.
